note: views_filters_summary_eref is a thin integration submodule of views_filters_summary. It has NO config, routes, permissions, or plugins; it only implements the alter hook(s) hook_views_filters_summary_info_alter (primary: views_filters_summary_info_alter) to let the parent's Views summary area render Entity Reference Exposed Filters's filters. Companion module: entity_reference_exposed_filters. Grounding: easy = code facts about the hook/behaviour; medium = live module-registry introspection (declared dependencies and the implemented hook, discoverable via the extension list / module source without the companion being active); hard = building/altering the parent views_filters_summary area on a real view (vfs_task / vfs_reset), verified against live view config — since the submodule's own effect only manifests when its companion module plus a matching exposed filter render inside that area.

evals.prompt: What does the Drupal submodule views_filters_summary_eref do, and which companion module (if any) does it integrate the Views Filters Summary with?
evals.expected_output: Renders node titles in the summary for the Entity Reference Exposed Filters (EREF) node-titles filter. Dependencies: views_filters_summary, entity_reference_exposed_filters.

evals.prompt: Which views_filters_summary alter hook (or core hook) does the views_filters_summary_eref submodule implement to do its job, and what does that implementation do?
evals.expected_output: It implements hook_views_filters_summary_info_alter. This submodule implements `hook_views_filters_summary_info_alter()`. For the EREF `eref_node_titles` filter it loads each referenced node by id and sets the summary value to the node's title (label), so the summary shows readable node titles instead of node ids. Requires the Entity Reference Exposed Filters module.

evals.prompt: In the views_filters_summary_eref submodule, describe the specific mapping or transformation it applies for its supported filter type in the Views Filters Summary.
evals.expected_output: This submodule implements `hook_views_filters_summary_info_alter()`. For the EREF `eref_node_titles` filter it loads each referenced node by id and sets the summary value to the node's title (label), so the summary shows readable node titles instead of node ids. Requires the Entity Reference Exposed Filters module.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, inspect the module registry / extension info for views_filters_summary_eref and report the module(s) it declares as dependencies in its info file.
evals.expected_output: views_filters_summary_eref declares these dependencies: views_filters_summary, entity_reference_exposed_filters (readable via the extension list, e.g. \Drupal::service('extension.list.module')->getAllAvailableInfo()['views_filters_summary_eref']['dependencies'], or the module's .info.yml).

evals.prompt: On this site, inspect the views_filters_summary_eref submodule and report which views_filters_summary (or core) alter hook it implements.

The views_filters_summary_eref submodule enhances the parent views_filters_summary area. On this site there is a view 'vfs_task' with an exposed Title filter but no filters summary. Add the 'Views exposed filters summary' area handler (plugin id views_filters_summary) to a display of that view and save it.
evals.expected_output: Add a handler with plugin_id 'views_filters_summary' under display_options.footer (or header/empty) of the vfs_task view and save it.

evals.prompt: On this site the view 'vfs_reset' shows a filters summary (the kind views_filters_summary_eref enhances) but has no reset-all link. Turn on the reset-all link for that summary and save the change.
evals.expected_output: Set the views_filters_summary area's show_reset_link option to TRUE on the vfs_reset view and save.
